row.reason: Paylocity sells cloud payroll/HCM software to mid-sized employers (HR, payroll, tax filing for employees). DFIN sells regulatory filing, deal/document and fund compliance software and services to public issuers, funds, law firms and banks in capital markets. Products and buyers differ. Both use software subscriptions plus services, but that is a generic similarity only.
